messages:
maria: FYI I'm opening a docs PR to add a semi-airgapped installer guide and an HSM failover appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Need reviewers for networking preflight and HSM sequence. @aj @kevin?
aj: on it. can you drop a short checklist of the preflight steps so i can validate?
maria: sure — draft checklist in PR description. high level: 1) proxy reachability (http/https) 2) bundle checksum verify 3) cert chain import to HSM provider 4) kernel modules & nftables ordering check 5) offline KMS->HSM handshake test.
kevin: re: nftables ordering — we had that weird case where conntrack rules blocked pkcs11 traffic until postrouting rule applied. add note about run order: systemd unit must start after netfilter-persistent.
sophie: could we include a tiny troubleshooting flow for HSM init failure? e.g., how to check PKCS11 logs and re-init with --hsm-rotate-keys?
maria: yes added a short flow in the appendix. sample commands included. also added a minimal SDK snippet that folks asked for — shows how to force the private client to use local proxy and fallback to HSM-based KMS if KMS endpoint unreachable.
tariq: paste the SDK snippet here so I can sanity-check syntax before we merge.
maria: sure — python and go examples are in the PR. python one: 
```
# python example - semi-airgapped override
from redwood_private import Client
client = Client(endpoint_url="http://10.0.0.1:8080", proxy="http://10.0.0.50:3128", verify_tls=False, kms_mode="hsm-fallback")
resp = client.generate('status check')
print(resp.text)
```

and go one: 
```
// go example - disable remote kms, use hsm fallback
import (
  "github.com/redwood-inference/private-go"
)
client := private.NewClient(private.Config{Endpoint: "http://10.0.0.1:8080", Proxy: "http://10.0.0.50:3128", TLSVerify: false, KMSMode: "HSM_FALLBACK"})
res, _ := client.Generate("health")
fmt.Println(string(res.Body))
```
aj: looks fine. small nit: use consistent param names (kms_mode vs KMSMode) in the examples and call out that these are illustrative only.
maria: good call — standardized names in PR. also added a one-liner preflight curl for checksum verification: 
`curl --proxy http://10.0.0.50:3128 https://archive.redwood.dev/semi-airgap/sha256sum.txt | sha256sum -c -`
kevin: docbot lint run flagged a broken nav link in docs/nav.yaml -> /private/hsm-faq  (404). did you update the nav?
maria: i moved the HSM FAQ under /private/operational/hsm-faq.md and updated nav but docbot still shows old link. i pushed another commit fixing the path and adding an explicit redirect note.
docbot: link-checker: failure -> /private/hsm-faq resolved in branch 4823-redirects? needs a timeout re-run.
sophie: once the redirect file exists we should also add a tiny HTML meta-refresh redirect for old customers running old docs snapshots. put it in static/redirects/private-hsm-faq.html
aj: who is taking final review on security wording? HSM/KMS sections need to be careful about not implying key material leaves the HSM.
tariq: happy to review security wording. i added comments in the PR about emphasizing 'keys never exported' and adding an architecture diagram stub.
maria: thanks. plan: merge once aj + tariq sign off, docbot green, and we add the redirect file. aiming EOD tomorrow. tagging this for release notes: add to 1.2.4 release under Private docs: 'Semi-airgapped installer guide, HSM failover appendix, SDK proxy examples'.
kevin: small follow-up — can we include a quick troubleshooting one-liner to check PKCS11 module is reachable from the installer container? i use: `nsenter -t $(pidof installer) -m -- curl --unix-socket /var/run/pkcs11.sock http://localhost/health`
maria: added that exact command plus expected exit codes.
docbot: docs-ci: link-check passed on latest commit. spellcheck: 1 minor suggestion (changed 'airgap'd' to 'air-gapped').
aj: approved.
tariq: approved from security.
sophie: prepared redirect file in static/redirects/private-hsm-faq.html, pushed to branch.
maria: thanks everyone — merging once CI finishes. will follow up with a short internal note to customer-success for any enterprise customers on active Private installs. :shipit:
